title: AMS-CeNN: An Auditable, Stability-Certified Cellular Residual Network for Robust Long-Horizon Engineering Forecasting
description: Reference implementation, experiment harness and per-seed result data for AMS-CeNN, a parameter-auditable, stability-certified cellular residual network for long-horizon multivariate time-series forecasting. Integrated into a pinned fork of NeuralForecast (v3.1.9); includes the model, the benchmark runner, the per-seed result files of every run reported in the associated manuscript (benchmark, ablations, efficiency profile, input-perturbation study) and the analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure from them. The associated manuscript is under submission (2026).
